title: Do LLMs Know Your Neighborhood? Auditing LLM Priors for Neighborhood-Level Mobility Prediction and Structural Alignment
reasoning: The paper evaluates whether LLMs can predict neighborhood-level mobility outcomes from socio-demographic and built-environment predictors, and assesses their structural alignment and potential biases (e.g., protected-group predictors). It does not contain any components related to evaluating faith, spiritual traditions, morals, or ethics.
